info.title: EDNS
info.description: Create, track and cancel SMS, email and push notifications that are delivered asynchronously.

get.description: The authenticated user's notifications, newest first, with optional filters and cursor pagination.

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: The earliest creation time (ISO 8601). An offset such as `+03:00` is honoured; a date alone means the start of that day in UTC.

parameters.name: created_to
parameters.description: The latest creation time (ISO 8601). An offset is honoured; a date alone, such as `2026-11-12`, includes that whole day in UTC.

A batch holds at most `notifications.batch.max_size` notifications (1000 by default).
`notifications` lists the result for every requested notification in request
order; a notification whose idempotency key was already used is returned as the
existing notification and keeps its original batch.

NotificationChannel.description: Identifies a delivery channel in storage, validation and the API. Each channel's rules live in its delivery channel implementation, resolved through {@see ChannelRegistry}.
NotificationChannel.title: NotificationChannel

NotificationStatus.description:
| | |---| | `waiting`
Persisted and waiting to be handed to the queue (outbox state). | | `scheduled`
Held back until its scheduled delivery time. | | `queued`
Pushed onto a queue and waiting for a worker. | | `processing`
Claimed by a worker and being delivered to the provider. | | `sent`
Accepted by the provider. | | `failed`
Permanently failed after exhausting its delivery attempts. | | `cancelled`
Cancelled before a worker picked it up. |
NotificationStatus.title: NotificationStatus
